verdict.rationale: Hightouch is a SaaS data and marketing platform, so an official CLI is a fair question to ask, but the evidence pack never mentions one. The pack documents a REST API, OpenAPI spec, SDKs, Git Sync and an MCP server. These are adjacent programmatic interfaces, not a CLI, and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
